title: configurable timer setting to turn off the keyboard's backlight
line: Power Management settings now have a "Turn off keyboard backlight" option that switches the keyboard backlight off after its own idle time, even while a video keeps the screen on.
explanation: The keyboard backlight was only turned off as a side effect of the Dim screen and Turn off screen actions, so it used the screen's timeouts and stayed on whenever an app inhibited screen power management, for example while a video plays. There was no way to give it a shorter timeout of its own. A new TurnOffKeyboardBacklight action with per-profile TurnOffKeyboardBacklightWhenIdle/IdleTimeoutSec settings turns the backlight off after its own idle time and restores the previous level on the next input; System Settings gets a "Turn off keyboard backlight" combobox (Never by default, 10 s to 5 min or custom) under Display and Brightness.

commits.message:
Add a timeout to turn off the keyboard backlight when idle

The keyboard backlight only turned off together with the screen, so it
stayed on while reading or watching a video. A new action and setting
turn it off after its own idle time and restore it on the next input.

BUG: 377357

media.caption: Power Management settings on master: no keyboard backlight timeout, only the brightness slider
With the change: new "Turn off keyboard backlight" combobox under the keyboard brightness slider
Master, 20 seconds without input: the keyboard backlight is still on (High)
Set to 10 seconds: after 10 seconds without input the backlight turns Off, and moving the pointer brings it back to High
